miko: Quick sync — two small but related things: 1) where should we put contextual hints vs inline error text for the new Dataset Import modal? 2) destructive actions: do we keep typed-confirm for single-row deletes or move to inline undo snackbar? jamal: For the modal, my leaning is: keep persistent helper text under labels for optional guidance, but reserve inline errors only for failed validation after submit/blur. Keeps the UI clean. :thinking_face: sara: Agree on keeping helper text persistent for things like file format notes. But for "required" signal, are we set on asterisks? a11y wise asterisk alone isn't announced by screenreaders. We should combine visual marker + `aria-required="true"`. laura: Strong +1 to aria-required. Also we should add an `aria-describedby` pointer from the input to the helper text node so SR hears the hint. Example: `
What to put here…
` ethan: For inline errors: do we show them on blur or only after submit? I'm worried about interrupting flow with red errors as folks type. miko: Proposal: show non-blocking validation (format checks) inline on blur, but only show blocking errors after submit. Also animate error appearing with gentle fade so it's not jarring. jamal: Works. Also let's be intentional about copy: inline error = short, imperative: "Enter a valid email", helper text = explanatory: "We use this to contact you about import failures." laura: Now destructive actions: typed-confirm (e.g., type the dataset name) is super effective for big deletions but feels heavy for single-row delete from a table. Maybe: modal with clear copy + backup undo via toast for row-level deletes. Keep typed-confirm for dataset-level deletes. sara: +1. We should add a risk-level mapping in the pattern doc: low risk = inline confirm + undo; medium = modal confirm with checkbox; high = typed-confirm. That makes design decisions repeatable. ethan: Edge-case: what if the delete is irreversible due to legal/regulatory reason? Then typed-confirm must be mandatory even for single items. We need a flag in the API to mark "regulatoryDeletion": true. miko: Good call. Add an optional `sensitiveDeletion` prop to the backend contract so UI can escalate. design-bot: New figma frame uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/import-modal-v2 — comment if you want updates. jamal: One small a11y nit for helper text density: avoid more than two helper lines below a control in narrow modals. Long helper text should be a "learn more" link opening side panel. laura: Also accessibility for destructive dialogs: move keyboard focus into the modal, trap focus, and ensure the confirm button is not focused by default to avoid accidental enter commits. sara: Copy suggestion for typed confirm prompt: instead of "Type the name to confirm", maybe "Enter the dataset name to permanently delete this dataset:" + bold dataset name inline. Clear and precise. miko: Okay actionable items: 1) jamal/laura — update the Figma to include aria-describedby examples and persistent helper text variants; 2) ethan — add `sensitiveDeletion` flag to delete API schema; 3) sara — draft the risk-level mapping doc snippet (2–3 bullets) for the patterns page; 4) me — I’ll codify copy tone and error microcopy. jamal: I'll mock the toast undo flow for row delete. ETA EOD. ethan: I'll add the backend flag in the PR and link it here when ready. laura: I'll add keyboard focus behavior notes to the modal component doc and include an example of not auto-focusing the confirm button. miko: Nice — thanks everyone. If no objections I'll fold into the validation patterns doc later today. :thumbsup:
